target_architecture_binding.wp507_boundary: WP507 is deterministic, immutable, persistence-agnostic and explicitly does not observe hidden model state. NNsight therefore cannot replace WP507's canonical contract; it is only a candidate downstream experimental instrumentation donor for model-specific causal tests.
target_architecture_binding.secondary_future_fit: WP806-class cognitive lesion/rescue and model-specific Global J-Space/GWT causal falsification after an exact local model/J-Space ABI exists.

source_verified_architecture.tracer: Captures user trace blocks, extracts source/AST and compiles intervention code; process-wide tracing/code caches reduce repeated setup cost.
source_verified_architecture.interleaver: Main model thread and Mediator worker threads coordinate model values/interventions via provider/requester events; eproperty accesses register one-shot hooks then block until matching providers fire.
source_verified_architecture.addressing: Intermediate values are addressed principally by module/operation path, property key and iteration suffix; this is useful instrumentation identity but is not F2 canonical causal-event/admission/broadcast/model-loader identity.
source_verified_architecture.intervention_surface: Supports activation read/write, swaps, module skip, gradients, barriers, batching/multiple invokes, source-operation tracing, scanning, caching and persistent model edits.
source_verified_architecture.source_tracing: Can AST-rewrite module forward methods and cache SourceAccessor state on modules, enabling below-module operation access but adding a distinct execution/provenance surface that must be measured rather than assumed neutral.
source_verified_architecture.model_loading: LanguageModel delegates model/tokenizer loading to HuggingFace-style from_pretrained flows with forwarded kwargs; device map, dtype, trust_remote_code, attention backend and dispatch therefore remain part of exact runtime identity.
source_verified_architecture.tests: Repository contains tiny-model tests for tracing, intervention, gradients, conditionals, sessions and early stopping, plus source, transform, iteration, memory-cleanup and performance tests; no upstream test result is imported as F2 runtime evidence.
source_verified_architecture.performance: Upstream documents measurable fixed trace/intervention overhead and process-wide caching; these are upstream measurements only and require F2-local characterization before any performance claim.

dependency_surface.assessment: Substantially heavier than a minimal native PyTorch hook adapter; full-library import is not justified at E2.

required_f2_fences_for_any_future_e3: Bind exact model checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime/build, loader-consumed identity, dtype, device map, attention implementation, trust_remote_code setting, RNG state and input digest outside NNsight.
Use local-only backend; prohibit NDIF/remote/API-key/provider paths.
Treat NNsight module-path/iteration/tensor-id identifiers as non-authoritative instrumentation metadata only.
Forbid persistent/in-place model.edit state across matched control/intervention arms; reconstruct or prove clean reset before each arm.
Record whether source tracing/AST forward rewriting is enabled; treat rewritten and native-hook execution as different experimental conditions unless equivalence is measured.
Require matched probe identity and identical non-intervention inputs for control/intervention pairs.
Add sham-hook, random-layer, equal-norm/noise and rescue controls so generic model damage cannot masquerade as GWT/J-Space causal influence.
Fail UNKNOWN on hook-path drift, provider-order mismatch, stale model generation, loader ambiguity or incomplete uptake evidence.
Keep all model/intervention outputs noncanonical; no state/effect/completion authority.
counterhypotheses: A minimal native PyTorch hook harness may provide the required causal intervention surface with materially lower dependency/provenance cost.
NNsight hook/interleaving/source-rewrite machinery may perturb execution enough to weaken causal attribution for small effects.
A changed downstream output after ablation may reflect generic model impairment rather than mechanism-specific GWT/J-Space influence.
Batched/multi-invoke execution can share scheduler or process state and therefore may not constitute independent matched arms without an explicit independence test.

preconditions: exact local zero-cost model/checkpoint and model-specific J-Space observation/intervention target are admitted
F2 provenance envelope can bind checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/loader/input/RNG identities
current execution authority still permits the selected local/free surface
next_exact_gate.experiment: Compare one minimal NNsight local read/zero/swap intervention against a native PyTorch-hook baseline on the same exact model/input, including no-op hook, random-site, equal-norm/noise and rescue arms. Measure output equivalence where no-op is expected, intervention specificity, hook/path identity, determinism and local overhead/RSS. Do not use NDIF or provider execution.
next_exact_gate.pass_condition: NNsight reproduces the intended local intervention with explicit identity binding and no-op/native-control equivalence inside declared tolerance while mechanism-specific intervention/rescue discriminates against sham/random controls.
next_exact_gate.fail_condition: identity cannot be bound, no-op changes results materially, source/hook path drifts, persistent edits contaminate arms, or native hooks achieve the same discriminator with clearly lower provenance/dependency cost.
